description: Wärme-, Strom- und Treibstoffverbrauch im Kanton Zürich ab 2010 is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Amt für Abfall, Wasser, Energie und Luft Kanton Zürich. Die Stromdaten stammen von der Eidgenössischen Elektrizitätskommission (ElCom), die Treibstoffdaten aus der schweizerischen Gesamtenergiestatistik des Bundesamts für Energie (BFE) und die Wärmedaten aus der kantonalen Statistik des Amts für Abfall, Wasser, Energie und Luft (AWEL). Coverage: Amt für Abfall, Wasser, Energie und Luft Kanton Zürich. The portal files it under the publisher Amt für Abfall, Wasser, Energie und Luft Kanton Zürich. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
